purpose: Chemistry subtask postflight: representative protein state, ligand/cofactor, ion and unsupported-chemistry handling in DynaMol. Software behavior and native numerical consistency only; no universal coverage, biological accuracy, state-population or convergence claims. Aggregate workspace/recovery/structural-analysis postflight remains separate.

reproducibility.hardware: Local Apple Silicon CPU; native AmberTools and OpenMM Reference/CPU; no cloud or GPU compute
reproducibility.budget: At most 12 unique ligand native parameterizations, 10-minute timeout per native command; <=20-step chemistry numerical-continuity simulations; recovery fixtures up to 400 OpenMM or 3,000 GROMACS steps to reach a checkpoint before interrupt/cancel/resume; existing curated PTM parity fixtures; no long production MD

inputs.matrix: Standard residue templates/protonation variants/termini/disulfide; SEP,TPO,PTR,HYP; neutral alcohol/aromatic, anionic carboxylate/phosphate, cationic amine, ATP/ADP/NAD/FAD; Na/Cl/K/Mg/Ca; expected rejection of unsupported elements, radicals, missing ligand atoms, covalent inhibitors/cofactors and unregistered amino acids. MSE/ALY only if compatible published parameters and native parity can be established.

reproducibility.source_hash_scope: Current source snapshot; per-ligand native provenance retains the exact implementation hash present when that ligand was prepared. Not an immutable packaged release.

data.policy: Preserve identities, elements, all deposited heavy atoms and stereochemistry; no parent-residue mutation, arbitrary GAFF on covalent proteins, fabricated parameters or silent removal. Keep view/identity/preparation/native-check status separate. Explicitly disclose fixed protonation assumptions and nonbonded ion limitations. Resume must preserve topology/system/config/platform compatibility and retained coordinates. RMSD/RMSF use documented selections, alignment/reference, units and handling of periodic boundaries.

validation.status: Passed bounded representative checks; broader scientific accuracy and convergence are unvalidated
limitations: Native positive fixtures are representative software checks, not an exhaustive applicability-domain validation.
Five 0.2-fs nonperiodic integration steps per chemistry fixture are numerical continuity only; no production dynamics or aqueous validation.
MSE/ALY and other unregistered unnatural residues still require dedicated compatible parameters.
NAD/FAD fixed states are model choices, not redox/protonation-population predictions.
Monatomic Mg/Ca parameters do not validate coordination energetics or bonded metal models.
Initial audit failures and test-fixture corrections are retained; final results are not a blind benchmark.

comparison.notes: No statistical efficacy/accuracy comparison. Meaningful uncertainty intervals cannot be inferred from deterministic implementation tests.

review_identity: Language-model evidence synthesis and automated PatAgent checklist; not a domain-expert certification or Pat Walters endorsement.

modeling.scope: Numerical native compatibility and defined software behavior, not scientifically converged dynamics.
